section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study that investigated a model hypothesizing that positive early memories are negatively associated with eating psychopathology, mediated by social safeness and a positive body appreciation. The path analysis was conducted on a sample of 490 women and confirmed the model's adequacy, explaining 51% of the variance in eating psychopathology. The results suggest that social safeness and body appreciation may contribute to prevention programs for eating psychopathology, controlling for BMI.
